perspective:
**From Angela Hwang’s perspective, she knows:**

- She is Angela Hwang, an Asian woman, a hairdresser with a doctorate, and she understands herself as having an ISFP personality.
- Kevin Flores is her close friend since high school. She knows he is a man, Latino, and a construction worker; they have different careers but confide in each other.
- She noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his construction job, so she invited him to coffee to talk.
- At coffee, Kevin told her he was “alright, just the usual grind,” then admitted he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was going through the motions. She asked if he had thought about a different job or career. He said he had thought about it but did not know where to start and felt overwhelmed. She offered to explore options with him; he agreed and thanked her.
- Later, Angela believed Kevin was considering a career change. She found job openings and a career counseling service and shared them with him. Kevin thanked her. She asked if he had thought more; he said he was interested in something creative, maybe design or architecture. She encouraged him to check the resources. He said he would and that her support meant a lot.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant, felt frustrated and worried, and arranged a meeting with a career coach. She told Kevin. He said he appreciated it but was not sure he was ready. She encouraged him; he agreed to give it a shot. He thanked her and said he did not know what he would do without her.
- Angela believed Kevin was making progress. She checked in about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident. She said she was proud and offered more help. He said just knowing she was there was enough, and he would tell her first if he needed anything. She said she would always be there.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career. She organized a small celebration party and told him. He thanked her and said it meant a lot, that he could not have done it without her. She said he did the hard work and she was glad to support him; they celebrated.
